info_sign_contract.zh_CN:
作为被授权方，如果您满足授权方的签约条件且接受授权方的授权策略，则可选择和授权方签约。
① 合约的复用。相同缔约方的合约可以在不同授权链中复用。
② 合约的应用和搁置。如果授权方和被授权方签订了多个合约，被授权方可以选择应用或者搁置其中某一个或某几个合约，但要保证至少有一个合约处于应用状态。搁置的合约在有效期内仍然正常运行（状态机正常接收事件），但在授权链中，系统仅验证处于应用中的合约的授权状态。
info_sign_contract.en_US:
As the licensee, if one meets the requirements imposed by policy and satisfied with the terms and conditions, then one may choose to sign the policy created by licensor and thus forming a new contract.
Please note:
① Contract can be reused: A single contract can be applied to different authorization chains.
② Contract can be suspended: If there exist multiple contract between the same licensor and licensee about the same subject, the licensee may suspend those contract(s) that intend to be exclude from authorization chain. Suspended contract receive events as usually, but no longer verified upon each authorization.
